mechanism_narrative: A 3-month positive change in CPIAUCSL of at least 0.5% predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as moderate inflation signals a strong economy without excessive risk, supporting corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the 3-month CPIAUCSL change is at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns, as high unemployment signals economic weakness and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL show a positive 3-month change, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns, as rising interest rates and inflation compress corporate profit margins and increase risk aversion.
regime_hint: monetary policy tightening combined with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL have a positive 3-month change.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime where the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns, as low unemployment signals an economy nearing its peak with increasing risk of a downturn.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0 thousand units, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns, as strong housing activity signals robust economic growth and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0 (index 2017=100), the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns, as strong manufacturing output signals robust economic activity and corporate demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500,000 million dollars, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns, as strong consumer spending supports corporate revenue growth and economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 500000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of GDP (GDPC1) is positive, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns, as expanding economic output strengthens corporate fundamentals and reduces recession risk.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the year-over-year GDP growth rate is positive.
